Platform module Worker only parses user PCM16 RIFF WAV≤1MiB/5s/mono-stereo8–48kHz before allocating samples, averages stereo, at most20 windows4096frames, 3sec termination. Original PitchDetector.findPitch performs actual estimation; platform limits RMS/clarity/range80–1200Hz and derives approximate 12-TET note using A4=440Hz. Not full-track analysis, expert calibration, voice/identity/medical assessment or confidence probability. Pure local input, CSVJSON only without filename/audio output. No microphone, upload, CDN, model or remote resource. True mobile/all devices and all signals not guaranteed.
